title: Collect every VCF Installer task page through VCF PowerCLI
prompt: Implement the exported Get-VcfInstallerTaskInventory function in src/VcfInstaller.TaskInventory/VcfInstaller.TaskInventory.psm1. The module integrates with the VCF Installer 9.1 getTasks operation through the prerequisite VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Installer PowerCLI module. Starting at pageNumber 0, retrieve every page using Invoke-VcfInstallerGetTasks, follow PageMetadata.TotalPages, and return all task objects ordered by CreationTimestamp ascending and then Id ascending. Always send pageNumber and pageSize (PageSize defaults to 100 and must be 1..100). Forward TaskStatus, TaskType, ResourceId, ResourceType, CompletedAfter, TaskName, and DoLiveRefresh only when the caller actually bound that parameter; an unset filter must be omitted from the SDK invocation and therefore from the request, including doLiveRefresh despite its OpenAPI default. Pass the supplied connected VCF Installer Server object to every SDK call. Reject missing page metadata and inconsistent page numbers rather than silently returning a partial collection. Do not use Invoke-RestMethod, Invoke-WebRequest, WebClient, HttpClient, curl, or another direct HTTP client. Keep the public command and manifest in place. The authoritative, spec-derived subset is docs/contract.json and its pinned provenance is docs/official_sources.json. The verifier uses a loopback VCF Installer service only; it never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
